summary: NightFood Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary TechForce Robotics entered into a Supply Agreement with Jiun Jiang Enterprise Co., Ltd. for manufacturing and technology development of robotic systems. The agreement outlines purchase orders, manufacturing, IP licensing, and quality standards. No terms such as price per share, premium, or board recommendation are mentioned. This is a routine commercial supply agreement, not a special situation filing. There are no deal terms, advisor, or regulatory clock involved.
